steps.title: After · Guild landing
steps.description: Four doors kept; Build now leads to the Shop floor. Deeper page tone.

steps.title: After · Shop floor (arrival)
steps.description: Status strip of five lights (shape + word; grey = unknown), with Usage & limits in place of Spend. Master Craftsman is docked as the main surface, with a rail of Needs you, Continue and Post-its. Detail is one tap away.

steps.title: After · Usage & limits per agent (the Spend light's detail)
steps.description: Each agent against its plan or prepaid balance: used, reset or refill, projected time to limit, headroom, vendor-reported warnings, and a shift-work hint. Overall spend is secondary. Sample data.

steps.title: After · The bench, one step away
steps.description: Same bench, now with bounded sections from the new tokens; layouts unchanged.
steps.alt: Build workbench after the token change
